claim_scope: This post-outcome bridge study measures strict action-sequence success on eight held level-5/6 synthetic MCP tasks. It compares a 12k Bonsai Hermes Lite packet with a separately receipted full Hermes gpt-4.1 lane configured for 160k context. It does not establish general agent capability, tool execution, stochastic robustness, or that RAM improves beyond this frozen task family.
